mapper.select: SELECT c.ID AS cartId, c.USER_ID, c.PRODUCT_ID, c.QUANTITY, p.NAME AS productName, p.PRICE, p.IMAGE_URL FROM TB_CART c INNER JOIN TB_PRODUCT p ON c.PRODUCT_ID = p.ID WHERE c.USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_CART SET QUANTITY = #{quantity}, UPDATE_DATE = NOW() WHERE ID = #{id}
